tagline: A home pizza guide and dough calculator

theme.toggle: Switch between light and dark theme

footer.disclaimer: Amounts and times are approximate; change one thing at a time.

home.title: Pizza dough, calculated for your oven.
home.sub: Choose a style and a size. Get exact grams and clear steps.
home.err_min_batch: The 2-hour warm method needs at least {min} pizzas. One pizza needs less than {min_g} g of yeast, and a scale that reads whole grams cannot measure that. Choose a cold method, or bake {min} pizzas.

recipe.placeholder: Detailed steps for this style are coming next.
recipe.table_note: The yeast solution replaces the same weight of water.
recipe.noscript: Without JavaScript this page shows 2 pizzas of 30 cm. Use the Home page to choose your own amounts.

new_york.name: New York
new_york.blurb: Foldable slice, crisp base, chewy rim. The main recipe of this guide and the best fit for a home oven.

neapolitan.name: Neapolitan
neapolitan.blurb: Soft centre and a tall, airy rim. No oil in the dough. In a home oven it is Neapolitan-style, not the real thing.

roman_tonda.name: Roman tonda
roman_tonda.blurb: Thin, crisp and light. The dough is rolled out with a rolling pin.

al_taglio.name: Al taglio
al_taglio.blurb: Roman tray pizza cut into squares. Very wet dough, open crumb, crisp base.

detroit.name: Detroit
detroit.blurb: Thick, airy, with a fried crisp base, baked in a rectangular pan.

chicago.name: Chicago deep dish
chicago.blurb: A tall pie with a thick dough in a deep pan.

warn.parchment: Check the maximum temperature printed on the pack of your baking paper. Many baking papers are rated to {max_c} degrees, below this oven. Do not let it touch the heating elements or oven walls.
warn.oil_smoke: Extra-virgin olive oil starts to smoke at about {min_c} to {max_c} degrees. In pans and on a hot tray use refined olive oil or a neutral oil (rapeseed, sunflower). Oil mixed into the dough is fine.
warn.min_batch: This method needs at least {min_pizzas} pizzas, and you chose {pizzas}. The yeast would be under {min_g} g, and a scale that reads whole grams cannot measure that.
warn.batch_too_small: This dough is too small to measure the yeast on a scale that shows whole grams. Make a bigger batch.
